notes: Layout-preset atom (LAYOUT-ENGINE-SPEC.md), built like Button. `cardType` is the variant enum — a designed layout, each living in Card.css keyed by `.card--{type}`. Slots are REAL ATOMS composed the way the other atoms compose them: the media cell uses the shared `media` node (Icon|LottieIcon|Image|Shape + mediaBg); the text slots are nested Heading/Text component nodes and the action a Button node — the author writes `{ component, …child props }` and the child atom owns its own props, exactly the FormField/Badge/Heading media pattern (no `_ref`). ATOM CHOSEN BY SEMANTICS, APPEARANCE CHOSEN FREELY ON TOP: each slot is typed to the atom the content STRUCTURALLY is — `title` is a Heading because it IS a heading (in the document outline, screen-reader navigable); `meta` is a Text because it is metadata, NOT a heading (never announced as one). The slot type GUARANTEES honest structure (an author can't downgrade a title to a non-heading, or make a caption announce as a heading); the preset CSS then styles each slot however it likes (a Heading can look small, a Text can look large) — visual freedom on top of fixed semantics. Textonly handling is CARD-LEVEL first: semanticRole='decorative' drops the whole card (it was chrome); 'content-symbol'/'ui-control' keeps it reduced; UNMARKED keeps the card fully (safe default — forgetting to tag never hides content from a reading-mode user). 'decorative' means the author has VERIFIED the card carries no information a reader needs — NOT merely that it 'looks visual'. Within a kept card, Heading/Text/Button slots are content-by-nature (kept); only media follows its own semanticRole. cardType=horizontal: media left (hug) | title + meta + body middle (fill, stacked) | Button right (hug, centred), equal-height row. Legacy variant/slot-children consumers are .astro-level (bypass this schema, pass no cardType) — Card.astro keeps a legacy fallback branch until each is rebuilt as a cardType and migrated to the JSON card test page.

_rules.action: Card auto-injects semanticRole='background' on the Shape (runtime guarantee; JSON value overridden) — same pattern as Heading/List/Badge.
_rules.note: Shape is wallpaper for the child atom; the child owns aria/label.

content._description: The atoms the chosen cardType arranges, plus the card-level reading-mode intent. Each slot is a nested component node (the FormField/Badge/Heading pattern, no `_ref`): the `component` enum names the child and the child atom owns its own props (Card only places the slot). Deep child-prop validation is the shared (B) nested pass (VALIDATOR-NESTED-SLOTS-SPEC.md), identical to every atom's media — not Card-specific.

title._description: Title — middle cell. Heading because it IS a heading (document outline, screen-reader navigable). Semantics fixed by the component enum; preset CSS styles appearance freely.

meta._description: Metadata line — top of the middle cell. Text because it is metadata, NOT a heading (never announced as one). Preset CSS styles it small/muted.

body._description: Body — middle cell, below title/meta. Text; preset CSS styles appearance.

semanticRole._description: Card-level reading-mode intent (same enum as the atoms). decorative = whole card dropped in textonly — author has VERIFIED it carries no information a reader needs (not just 'looks visual'). content-symbol / ui-control = card kept, reduced. OMITTED = card kept fully (safe default; never hides content). Heading/Text/Button slots are content-by-nature and kept; only media follows its own semanticRole.

media._description: Media cell — the shared media-node pattern (identical to Heading/Button/List/Shape).
Nested atom node. Default: a single atom (Icon | LottieIcon | Image | Shape). mediaBg=true: a Shape wrapping a child atom as a background container.

mediaBg._description: true = media is a Shape wrapping a child atom (background container).

mediaBgSize._note: Forwarded to the Shape wrapper. Implicit baseline 'normal'. Omit to use.

mediaSize._note: Forwarded to the child atom. Implicit baseline 'auto'. Omit to use.

visual._description: How the card is arranged — the layout preset (the variant enum, exactly like Button's variant).

cardType.description: Designed layout preset. Picks a fixed arrangement; sizing/placement are the preset's job, not the author's. More types (product, profile, feature, …) added as each is built.
